title: Meeting assistant
description: When a transcript wakes the meeting assistant. The default is the value the stack was deployed with; a value set here is used instead until it is reset.
appliesText: A saved change applies within about five minutes, to transcript segments processed after that.

wakePhraseRegex.title: Wake phrase (regular expression)
wakePhraseRegex.description: A Python regular expression searched for in each finished transcript segment; a segment it matches is sent to the meeting assistant. A pattern that is not a valid regular expression is logged and the deployment's own is used. Default: the AssistantWakePhraseRegEx stack parameter.
